resources.string: Asks you to tap when your computer wants the clipboard. Android only lets GeekBridge read it after a tap.
Tap to send what you just copied.
Waiting for your computer to connect.
Ready: copy, then tap the Send clipboard tile or use the computer\'s shortcut.
Ready: copy, then use the computer\'s shortcut and tap the notification. Tap here to add the Send clipboard tile.
Ready: copy, then use the computer\'s shortcut and tap the notification. You can add the Send clipboard tile in Quick Settings.
Blocked: notifications are off, so the computer can\'t ask for a tap. Copy, then tap the Send clipboard tile or the button above. Tap here to allow notifications.
Blocked: the phone was locked. Unlock it and copy again.
Blocked: the last item was marked sensitive (like a password), so it wasn\'t sent.
Blocked: the last item was too large to send.
Android didn\'t let GeekBridge read the clipboard. Unlock the phone and try again.
